title: Rename saved destination/property identifiers
prerequisites: Map real old save identifiers to verified new ones, then test an old save copy.
notes: RF RailForge/game-migrations files use top-level waybillDestinations, properties and carTypes dictionaries, with scalar targets or supported target objects.
FUSE compatibility executes scalar waybillDestinations/properties only. Object-valued RF records and carTypes are not FUSE execution parity.
